title: Dashboards
noDashboardsDescription: Dashboards gather charts, KPIs, and timelines onto one canvas. They only display data — nothing you see here can be edited from a dashboard.
deleteDashboardConfirm: The dashboard will be sent to the trash. You can restore it from Settings → Trash before the retention period ends.
name: Name
settingsDescription: Manage dashboard details, access, and advanced options.
dangerZoneDescription: Destructive actions. Deleted dashboards go to the trash and can be restored before the retention period ends.

notFoundDescription: The dashboard you're looking for does not exist or has been removed.
noAccessDescription: You do not have permission to view this dashboard.
tagsDescription: Add tags to organize and filter dashboards.
noWriteAccessTags: You need write access to manage tags.
